title: Detector's response to coherent Rindler and Minkowski photons
summary: We observe that the transition probability in a static two-level quantum detector interacting with a coherent Rindler field mode differs from that of the Rindler detector interacting with a coherent Minkowski field mode. The situation does not change in the quantum detector's response in the semiclassical limit of the field state. This we investigate in $(1+1)$ and $(3+1)$-spacetime dimensions.
